paragraphs: Boston Omaha Corporation, which we refer to as "the Company," "our Company," "we," "us" or "our," commenced its current business operations in June 2015 and currently operates four separate lines of business: outdoor billboard advertising, broadband services, surety insurance and related brokerage activities, and an asset management business. In addition, we hold minority investments in commercial real estate management and brokerage services, a bank focused on servicing the automotive loan market, a company serving the broadband industry, and a publicly-traded developer of private aviation infrastructure focused on building, leasing and managing business aviation hangars.

In June 2015, we commenced our billboard business operations through acquisitions by our wholly owned subsidiary, Link Media Holdings, LLC, which we refer to as "Link," of smaller billboard companies located in the Southeast United States and Wisconsin. During July and August 2018, we acquired the membership interest or assets of three larger billboard companies which increased our overall billboard count to approximately 2,900 billboards. In addition, we have made several billboard acquisitions on a smaller scale since that date. We believe that we are a leading outdoor billboard advertising company in the markets we serve in the Midwest. As of December 31, 2025, we operate approximately 3,900 billboards with approximately 7,500 advertising faces. One of our principal business objectives is to continue to acquire additional billboard assets through acquisitions of existing billboard businesses in the United States when they can be made at what we believe to be attractive prices relative to other opportunities generally available to us.

We are attracted to the outdoor advertising market due to a number of factors, including high regulatory barriers to building new billboards in some states, growing demand, low maintenance capital expenditures for static billboards, low cost per impression for customers, and the potential opportunity to employ more capital in existing assets at reasonable returns in the form of perpetual easements and digital billboard conversions. In addition, unlike other advertising industries, the internet has not had a material adverse impact on outdoor advertising revenues. The billboard industry's three largest companies are estimated to account for more than 50% of the industry's total revenues, and several industry sources and our experience suggest that there are a large number of other companies serving the remainder of the market, providing a potentially significant source of billboards which may be acquired in the future.

In September 2015, we established an insurance subsidiary, General Indemnity Group, LLC, which we refer to as "GIG," designed to own and operate insurance businesses generally handling high volume, lower policy limit commercial lines of property and casualty insurance. In April 2016, our surety insurance business commenced with the acquisition of a surety insurance brokerage business with a national internet-based presence. In December 2016, we completed the acquisition of United Casualty and Surety Insurance Company, which we refer to as "UCS," a surety insurance company, which at that time was licensed to issue surety bonds in only nine states. UCS now has licenses to operate in all 50 states and the District of Columbia. In addition, we have also acquired additional surety insurance brokerage businesses located in various regions of the United States. We currently operate our insurance brokerage businesses under our BOSS Bonds™ tradename. We offer independent insurance agents the opportunity to purchase surety insurance through our computerized portal which offers speed and ease in application processing for the independent agent. We may in the future expand the reach of our insurance activities to other forms of insurance which may have similar characteristics to surety, such as high volume and low average policy premium insurance businesses which historically have similar economics.

In April 2019, we established a broadband subsidiary, Fiber is Fast, LLC, which has changed its name to Boston Omaha Broadband, LLC, which we refer to as "BOB." In March 2020, our subsidiary, FIF AireBeam LLC, which we refer to as "AireBeam," acquired substantially all of the business assets of FibAire Communications, LLC, which we refer to as "FibAire," a rural broadband internet provider that served over 8,000 customers in communities in southern Arizona with a high-speed fixed wireless internet service and is building an all fiber-to-the-home network in select Arizona markets. In December 2020, we acquired substantially all of the business assets of Utah Broadband, LLC, which we refer to as "UBB," a broadband internet provider that provided high-speed internet to over 10,000 customers throughout Utah. In September 2021, we announced the launch of Fiber Fast Homes, LLC, which we refer to as "FFH," which partners with builders, developers and build for rent communities to build fiber-to-the-home infrastructure and provide fiber internet service to residents. In April 2022, we acquired substantially all of the business assets of InfoWest, Inc. and Go Fiber LLC, which we refer to on a combined basis now as "InfoWest," fiber and fixed wireless internet service providers with over 20,000 customers throughout Southern and Central Utah, Northern Arizona, and Moapa Valley, Nevada. In addition, over the last few years, we have also acquired additional smaller broadband businesses located in Utah. As of December 31, 2025, we have approximately 49,500 broadband customers (19,900 fiber customers) and 48,300 fiber passings completed. We hope to continue to expand in Arizona, Florida, Nevada, Utah, and other locales.

In September 2017, we established an asset management subsidiary, Boston Omaha Asset Management, LLC, which we refer to as "BOAM," designed to raise third-party capital and invest alongside Boston Omaha Corporation in specific assets and businesses that may offer attractive long-term returns on invested capital. During 2021, we established a subsidiary, Fund One: Boston Omaha Build for Rent, LP ("BFR Fund"), within BOAM to operate a proposed build-for-rent business, focusing on developing, building, and managing single family detached and/or townhomes for long term rentals. In 2022, we started having initial conversations to raise third-party capital to "fund finance" the growth of our fiber business. In May 2023, we acquired 100% of the membership interests in 24th Street Asset Management LLC ("24th Street"), from the other members of 24th Street. Prior to the acquisition, BOAM indirectly owned 48% of the membership interests of 24th Street. 24th Street is the manager of two funds, 24th Street Fund I, LLC and 24th Street Fund II, LLC, which we refer to as "the 24th Street Funds," focusing on secured lending and direct investments in commercial real estate.

In recent years, BOAM has been staffed and equipped to support the growth of the fiber and real estate businesses. The high costs and significant risks associated with "fund financing" based on current market conditions led us to conclude that it would be more appropriate to pursue self-funding, bank debt, and other funding options for our fiber business at this time. As a result, we are winding down BOAM's operations and over the past 18 months have implemented significant cost cutting measures as BOAM now only manages real estate funds. With respect to our funds under management (the 24th Street Funds and the BFR Fund), we have been selling the underlying real estate assets at the highest price the market will bear with only a few projects still to be sold. Additionally, we will be returning capital to our fund partners during the wind-down process on the remaining portion of these assets.
Since 2015, we have made minority investments in several different industries.

Since September 2015, we have made a series of investments in commercial real estate, a commercial real estate management, brokerage and related services business as well as an asset management business. We currently own 30% of Logic Real Estate Companies, LLC, which we refer to as "Logic." On May 1, 2023, our BOAM subsidiary acquired 100% of the membership interests in 24th Street, from the members of 24th Street other than BOAM, for cash and BOC Class A common stock valued at $5,016,494 in the aggregate. Prior to the transaction, BOAM indirectly owned 48% of the membership interests of 24th Street. The consideration consisted of $2,759,072 in cash at closing, an additional $1,254,102 in cash subject to holdback, and 45,644 shares of BOC Class A common stock (based on the average closing price of BOC Class A common stock for the 30 business day period ending two days before the closing date). The shares issued in the transaction are unregistered and have no registration rights. The purchase agreement also provides for certain payments based on performance to receive the holdback amount and certain other potential limited earnout payments. In addition, we have invested, through one of our subsidiaries, an aggregate of $6 million in the 24th Street Funds. These funds are managed by 24th Street and focus on opportunities within secured lending and direct investments in commercial real estate.

In December 2017, we invested $10 million in common units of Dream Finders Holdings LLC, which we refer to as "DFH," the parent company of Dream Finders Homes, LLC, a national home builder. In addition to its homebuilding operations, DFH's subsidiaries provide mortgage loan origination and title insurance services to homebuyers. On January 25, 2021, Dream Finders Homes, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of DFH, completed its initial public offering and Dream Finders Homes, Inc. became a holding company and sole manager of DFH. Upon completion of the initial public offering, our outstanding common units in DFH were converted into 4,681,099 shares of Class A common stock of Dream Finders Homes, Inc., and one of our subsidiaries purchased an additional 120,000 shares of Class A common stock in the initial public offering. Since DFH's initial public offering through December 31, 2022, we have sold all our 4,801,099 shares of DFH Class A common stock for gross proceeds of approximately $81 million.

In May 2018, through one of our subsidiaries, we invested approximately $19 million through the purchase of common stock of CB&T Holding Corporation, which we refer to as "CB&T," the privately-held parent company of Crescent Bank & Trust, Inc., which we refer to as "Crescent." Our investment now represents 15.6% of CB&T's outstanding common stock. Crescent is located in New Orleans and generates the majority of its revenues from indirect subprime automobile lending across the United States.

In October 2020, our subsidiary BOC Yellowstone LLC, which we refer to as "BOC Yellowstone," served as sponsor for the underwritten initial public offering of a special purpose acquisition company named Yellowstone Acquisition Company, which we refer to as "Yellowstone." Between August and November 2020, we invested, through BOC Yellowstone, approximately $7.8 million through the purchase of 3,399,724 shares of Class B common stock and 7,719,779 non-redeemable private placement warrants, each warrant entitling us to purchase one share of Class A common stock at $11.50 per share. In August 2021, Yellowstone entered into a business combination agreement with Sky Harbour LLC, which we refer to as "SHG," a developer of private aviation infrastructure focused on building, leasing and managing business aviation hangars. The business combination was completed on January 25, 2022 and Yellowstone changed its name to Sky Harbour Group Corporation, which we refer to as "Sky Harbour." Sky Harbour's Class A common stock trades on the NYSE under the symbol "SKYH" and its warrants to purchase Class A common stock trade under the symbol "SKYH.WS."

In September 2021, through one of our subsidiaries, we invested $55 million directly into SHG and received Series B preferred units, which we refer to "Sky Series B Preferred Units." Upon the successful consummation of the Sky Harbour business combination, this investment converted into 5,500,000 shares of Sky Harbour's Class A common stock based upon an assumed value of $10.00 per share. In December 2021, we agreed to provide Sky Harbour an additional $45 million through the purchase of 4,500,000 shares of Class A common stock upon the closing of the Sky Harbour business combination, which was consummated in January 2022. Through December 31, 2025, we have sold 1,015,537 shares of Sky Harbour Class A common stock for gross proceeds of approximately $11.2 million. As of December 31, 2025, we held 11,671,494 shares of Sky Harbour Class A common stock and 7,719,779 Sky Harbour warrants.

In 2021, we established the BFR Fund subsidiary within BOAM to operate a proposed build-for-rent business, focusing on developing, building, and managing single family detached and/or townhomes for long term rentals. We invested approximately $15 million of capital to finance the initial acquisitions for these projects and subsequently raised third-party capital to be invested alongside our capital. The BFR Fund acquired land parcels in Nevada with the initial plan to develop, construct, and operate build-for-rent communities. However, challenges in the market, including the increase in interest rates and the inability to achieve what we believe are appropriate risk-adjusted returns, have led us to pursue selling the remaining BFR Fund's entitled land assets to public homebuilders. Consequently, we are winding down the BFR Fund earlier than originally targeted. We have returned the uninvested cash on hand to BFR Fund partners and, as we sell the BFR Fund's entitled land assets, returning that capital to BFR Fund partners as well.

headings: Risks Related to the Company and Our Business
We have incurred losses from operations since inception and we anticipate that we will continue to incur losses for the foreseeable future.
Our failure to successfully identify and complete future acquisitions of assets or businesses could reduce future potential earnings, reduce available cash and slow our anticipated growth.
We may have difficulty integrating the operations of companies or businesses that we may acquire and may incur substantial costs in connection therewith.
Increased operating expenses associated with the expansion of our business may negatively impact our operating income.
We could suffer losses due to asset impairment charges for goodwill and other intangible assets.

We may raise additional equity capital through additional public or private placements, and issue equity securities under our 2022 Long-Term Incentive Plan, any of which could substantially dilute your investment.
Our investments in Sky Harbour Group Corporation's Class A common stock and Sky Warrants and other publicly traded and privately-held securities involve a substantial degree of risk.
We run the risk of inadvertently being deemed an investment company required to register under the Investment Company Act of 1940.
Restrictive covenants in Link's indebtedness and BOB's indebtedness may limit management's discretion with respect to certain business matters.
If we are unable to manage our interest rate risk effectively, our cash flows and operating results may suffer.

We may raise additional capital pursuant to debt financing, and such debt financing arrangements may contain covenants, which, if not complied with, could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition.
We may be unable to access capital.
Adverse economic conditions could negatively affect our results of operations and financial condition.
Climate change, severe weather, natural disasters, public health emergencies and other external events could significantly impact our business.
We may be unable to employ a sufficient number of key employees and other experienced or qualified workers.
We are heavily reliant upon our executive management team.
Our executive officers and directors may experience a conflict of interest between their duties to us and to affiliated parties.
Changes in laws and regulations governing data privacy and data protection could have a material adverse impact on our business.
Governmental regulations could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects.
Surety Insurance. We are subject to maintaining compliance within the highly regulated insurance industry as we continue our pursuit of opportunities in that market,
paragraphs: An investment in shares of our common stock is highly speculative and involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider all of the risks discussed below, as well as the other information contained in this Annual Report. If any of the following risks or uncertainties actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flow and prospects could be materially adversely affected. Additional risks or uncertainties not currently known to us, or that we deem immaterial, may also have a material adverse effect on our business' financial condition, results of operations or prospects. We cannot assure you that any of the events discussed in the risk factors below will not occur. In that case, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline and you may lose all or a part of your investment.

We have incurred losses from operations in each year since 2015, when Magnolia and Boulderado purchased majority ownership in the company, sold the prior business and commenced new business activities. Our net loss from operations for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 was approximately $3.9 million and $8.5 million, respectively. We have funded our operations to date principally from the sale of securities. In addition, as we acquire other businesses, we incur ongoing depreciation and amortization charges, which are typically spread over a number of years, as well as the costs of completing such acquisitions, which are expensed as incurred. Our losses may also include our pro rata portion of losses incurred by Sky Harbour as we account for our investment in Sky Harbour under the equity method of accounting. For these reasons, we may continue to incur significant losses. These losses, among other things, have had and will continue to have an adverse effect on our stockholders' equity and working capital and we cannot assure you that we will be able to be successful in implementing our business strategy.

The acquisition of assets or businesses that we believe to be valuable to our business is an important component to our business strategy. We believe that a wide variety of acquisition opportunities may arise from time to time, and that any such acquisition could be significant. At any given time, discussions with one or more potential sellers may be at different stages, including negotiations following the execution of nonbinding letters of intent. However, any such discussions, including the execution of nonbinding letters of intent, may not result in the consummation of an acquisition transaction, and we may not be able to identify or complete any acquisitions. The costs and benefits of future acquisitions are uncertain. In addition, the market and industry reception to our acquisitions, or lack thereof, may not be positive, and is out of our control. We cannot predict the effect, if any, that any announcement or consummation of an acquisition would have on the trading price of our Class A common stock. If we identify appropriate acquisition targets, we may be unable to acquire businesses on terms that we consider acceptable due to a variety of factors, including competition from other strategic buyers or financial buyers, some of which may have more experience or more access to capital than we do.

Our business is capital intensive and any such transactions could involve the payment by us of a substantial amount of cash. We may need to raise additional capital through public or private debt or equity financings to execute our growth strategy and to fund acquisitions. Adequate sources of capital may not be available when needed on acceptable terms, or at all. If we raise additional capital by issuing additional equity securities, the position of existing stockholders may be diluted. Acquisitions could also result in us incurring additional debt and contingent liabilities and fluctuations in quarterly results and expenses. If our capital resources are insufficient at any time in the future, we may be unable to fund acquisitions, take advantage of business opportunities or respond to competitive pressures, any of which could harm our business.

Any future acquisitions could present a number of risks, including but not limited to the risk of using management time and resources to pursue acquisitions that are not successfully completed, the risk of incorrect assumptions regarding future results of acquired operations, and the risk of diversion of management's attention from existing operations or other priorities. Future acquisitions can also be expected to generate additional depreciation and amortization charges which may contribute to losses. Acquisitions may never meet our expectations.

If we are unsuccessful in identifying and completing acquisitions of other operations or assets, our financial condition could be adversely affected and we may be unable to implement an important component of our business strategy successfully.

In each of our businesses, we hope to expand our geographic reach and market share and seek to develop a competitive advantage and/or brand name for our services, which we hope will be a differentiating factor for customers. Our insurance market primarily services small contractors, small and medium-sized businesses and individuals required to provide surety bonds (i) in connection with their work for government agencies and others, (ii) in connection with contractual obligations, or (iii) to meet regulatory requirements and other needs. We have expanded the licensing of the UCS business to all 50 states and the District of Columbia and developed and brought to market an electronic portal allowing independent insurance agents to more easily and efficiently purchase surety insurance. In outdoor advertising, our plan is to continue to grow this business through acquisitions of billboard assets. We expect to expand our broadband services in Arizona, Florida, Nevada, Utah and in other locations. In the future, we expect to expand the range of services we provide in the insurance sector, seek to continue to expand our billboard operations and broadband services and to possibly consider acquisitions of other businesses, as well as investments, in other sectors, although we expect to place a primary emphasis on growing our existing business lines over the next several years. Our decision to expand outside of these current business sectors we serve or in which we have made investments will be based on the opportunity to acquire businesses which we believe provide the potential for sustainable earnings at an attractive level relative to capital employed and, with regard to investment, we believe have the potential to provide attractive returns.

We seek to enter markets where we believe demand for our services will grow in the coming years due to certain barriers to entry and/or to anticipated long-term demand for these services. In the outdoor billboard business, government restrictions often limit the number of additional billboards that may be constructed. At the same time, advances in billboard technology provide the opportunity to improve revenues through the use of digital display technologies and other new technologies. In the surety insurance business, new insurance companies must be licensed by state agencies that impose capital, management and other strict requirements on these insurers. These hurdles are at the individual state level, with statutes often providing wide latitude to regulators to impose judgmental requirements upon new entrants. In addition, new distribution channels in certain areas of surety may provide a new opportunity. In the real estate management services market, we believe the continued growth of commercial real estate in many sections of the United States will provide opportunities for management services for the foreseeable future. We also believe our investment in both CB&T and Sky Harbour has provided each company the opportunity to significantly grow its business. We invest our available capital and the surplus capital from UCS in a wide range of securities, including equity securities of public companies, various corporate and government bonds and U.S. treasuries. In broadband services, we believe that our fiber-to-the-home services can compete with traditional cable operators as broadband provides higher rates of transmission and improved speed to consumers and that, once built, other competitors may be less willing to compete in communities which we serve.

paragraphs: Boston Omaha Corporation，我們簡稱為 "本公司"、"我們的公司"、"我們"、"我們的" 或 "我們的公司"，於 2015 年 6 月開始目前的業務運作，目前經營四個獨立的業務線：戶外看板廣告、寬頻服務、擔保保險及相關經紀活動，以及資產管理業務。此外，我們持有少數投資於商業不動產管理與經紀服務、專注於汽車貸款市場服務的銀行、服務寬頻產業的公司，以及公開上市的私人航空基礎設施開發商，專注於建造、出租及管理商業航空機庫。

我們於 2015 年 6 月透過我們全資子公司 Link Media Holdings, LLC（我們簡稱為 "Link"）收購位於美國東南地區與威斯康辛州的較小看板公司，開始我們的看板業務運作。於 2018 年 7 月及 8 月，我們收購三家較大看板公司的股權或資產，使我們的總看板數增加至約 2,900 個看板。此外，自該日期起，我們也進行了數筆規模較小的看板收購。我們認為我們在服務的中西部市場是領先的戶外看板廣告公司。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們運作約 3,900 個看板，約有 7,500 個廣告面。我們的主要業務目標之一是持續透過收購美國現有的看板業務來取得更多看板資產，當這些收購能在我們認為具吸引力的價格進行時。

我們被戶外廣告市場所吸引，是因為許多因素，包括在某些州建設新看板的高規範限制、成長中的需求、靜態看板的低維護資本支出、對客戶而言的低每印象成本，以及在現有資產中運用更多資本的潛在機會，以合理的回報形式如永續使用權及數位看板轉換。此外，與其他廣告產業不同，網際網路對戶外廣告收入並未造成重大負面影響。看板產業的三大公司估計佔產業總收入的超過 50%，而根據產業來源及我們的經驗，顯示還有許多其他公司服務市場的剩餘部分，這可能成為未來收購看板的潛在來源。

我們於 2015 年 9 月設立了一家保險子公司 General Indemnity Group, LLC（我們簡稱為 "GIG"），專門經營處理高交易量、低保額的商業財產與責任保險業務。我們於 2016 年 4 月透過收購一家擁有全國網際網路業務的擔保保險經紀公司，開始我們的擔保保險業務。我們於 2016 年 12 月完成收購 United Casualty and Surety Insurance Company（我們簡稱為 "UCS"），一家擔保保險公司，當時僅在九個州有發行擔保債券的許可。UCS 現在已取得在所有 50 個州及華盛頓特區運作的許可。此外，我們也收購了位於美國各個地區的其他擔保保險經紀公司。我們目前透過 BOSS Bonds™ 商標運作我們的保險經紀業務。我們為獨立保險經紀提供機會，透過我們的電腦化入口網站購買擔保保險，提供給獨立經紀快速且簡易的申請處理。我們未來可能擴展我們的保險業務至其他類似擔保保險的保險形式，例如高交易量及低平均保單 premium 的保險業務，這些業務過去有相似的經濟特性。

我們於 2019 年 4 月設立了一家寬頻子公司 Fiber is Fast, LLC，後改名為 Boston Omaha Broadband, LLC（我們簡稱為 "BOB"）。我們於 2020 年 3 月透過我們的子公司 FIF AireBeam LLC（我們簡稱為 "AireBeam"）收購 FibAire Communications, LLC（我們簡稱為 "FibAire"）的 substantially all 業務資產，FibAire 是一家服務南亞利桑那州社區的鄉村寬頻互聯網供應商，擁有超過 8,000 名客戶，提供高速固定無線電互聯網服務，並正在建設選擇性亞利桑那州市場的全纖維到家網路。我們於 2020 年 12 月收購 Utah Broadband, LLC（我們簡稱為 "UBB"）的 substantially all 業務資產，UBB 是一家提供高速互聯網服務給超過 10,000 名客戶的寬頻互聯網供應商，服務遍及猶他州。我們於 2021 年 9 月宣佈啟動 Fiber Fast Homes, LLC（我們簡稱為 "FFH"），與建築師、開發商及建租社區合作，建設纖維到家基礎設施並為居民提供纖維互聯網服務。我們於 2022 年 4 月收購 InfoWest, Inc. 和 Go Fiber LLC 的 substantially all 業務資產，我們現在合併簡稱為 "InfoWest"，是一家提供纖維及固定無線電互聯網服務的供應商，服務超過 20,000 名客戶，遍及美國南部及中部猶他州、北部亞利桑那州及內華達州莫帕谷。此外，過去幾年我們也收購了位於猶他州的其他小型寬頻業務。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們擁有約 49,500 名寬頻客戶（19,900 名纖維客戶）及 48,300 名纖維通訊完成。我們希望持續在亞利桑那州、佛羅裏達州、內華達州、猶他州及其他地區擴張。

我們於 2017 年 9 月設立了一家資產管理子公司 Boston Omaha Asset Management, LLC（我們簡稱為 "BOAM"），專門用來募集第三方資金並與 Boston Omaha Corporation 一起投資於可能提供吸引人長期回報的特定資產與業務。我們於 2021 年設立了一家子公司 Fund One: Boston Omaha Build for Rent, LP（簡稱為 "BFR Fund"），在 BOAM 內運作一個預計的建租業務，專注於開發、建設及管理單戶住宅及/或聯排別墅，用於長期出租。我們於 2022 年開始與第三方資金進行初步對話，以 "fund finance" 方式資助我們的纖維業務成長。我們於 2023 年 5 月收購了 24th Street Asset Management LLC（簡稱為 "24th Street"）100% 的成員權益，從 24th Street 的其他成員處取得。在收購前，BOAM 間接擁有 24th Street 48% 的成員權益。24th Street 是兩支基金 24th Street Fund I, LLC 和 24th Street Fund II, LLC（簡稱為 "the 24th Street Funds"）的經理，專注於擔保貸款及直接投資於商業不動產。

近年來，BOAM 已配置人力與設備支持纖維及不動產業務的成長。根據目前市場條件，"fund financing" 的高成本及重大風險使我們認為，目前更適合透過自籌資金、銀行貸款及其他資金選項來資助我們的纖維業務。因此，我們正在收縮 BOAM 的運作，過去 18 個月已實施大量成本削減措施，目前 BOAM 僅管理不動產基金。關於我們管理中的基金（the 24th Street Funds 和 BFR Fund），我們正在以市場能承擔的最高價格出售其下的不動產資產，僅有少數項目尚未出售。此外，我們將在收縮過程中，將這些資產的剩餘部分回饋給基金合作夥伴。
自 2015 年以來，我們在不同產業中進行了少數投資。

自2015年9月起，本公司已於商業不動產、商業不動產管理、仲介及相關服務業務以及資產管理業務進行一系列投資。本公司目前持有Logic Real Estate Companies, LLC 30%的股權，本公司稱之為"Logic"。2023年5月1日，本公司之BOAM子公司以現金及BOC Class A普通股，總計價值5,016,494美元，向24th Street其他股東（非BOAM）購入24th Street 100%的有限合夥權益。交易前，BOAM間接持有24th Street 48%的有限合夥權益。交易對價包含於交易日現金2,759,072美元，額外現金1,254,102美元待扣留，以及45,644股BOC Class A普通股（基於交易日往前30個營業日的平均收盤價計算）。本次發行之股票為未註冊股票，且無註冊權。買賣契約亦規定基於績效支付之條件，以取得扣留金額及某些其他潛在有限買斷付款。此外，本公司透過一子公司，於24th Street Funds累計投資6百萬美元。這些基金由24th Street管理，專注於 secured lending 以及商業不動產之直接投資機會。

2017 年 12 月，本公司投資 10 百萬美元於 Dream Finders Holdings LLC 的普通單位，本公司稱之為 "DFH"，為 Dream Finders Homes, LLC 的母公司，為一家全國性住宅建造商。除了住宅建造業務外，DFH 的子公司亦提供住宅買方房貸貸款發放及不動產過戶保險服務。2021 年 1 月 25 日，Dream Finders Homes, Inc.（為 DFH 的 wholly owned subsidiary）完成首次公開發行，Dream Finders Homes, Inc. 成為 DFH 的控股公司及唯一管理人。首次公開發行完成後，本公司持有的 DFH 普通單位轉換為 4,681,099 張 Dream Finders Homes, Inc. 的 Class A 普通股，且本公司之一家子公司於首次公開發行中購入額外 120,000 張 Class A 普通股。自 DFH 首次公開發行至 2022 年 12 月 31 日，本公司已出售所有 4,801,099 張 DFH Class A 普通股，總計約獲取 81 百萬美元的毛收入。

2018 年 5 月，透過我們的一家子公司，我們透過購入 CB&T Holding Corporation 的普通股，投資約 19 百萬美元，我們稱為 "CB&T"，為 Crescent Bank & Trust, Inc. 的私人持有母公司，我們稱為 "Crescent"。我們的投資目前佔 CB&T 浮動普通股的 15.6%。Crescent 位於紐奧良，其收入主要來自美國境內的間接次級汽車貸款業務。

2020年10月，我們的子公司BOC Yellowstone LLC，我們簡稱為"BOC Yellowstone"，擔任特殊目的收購公司Yellowstone Acquisition Company（簡稱為"Yellowstone"）經由承銷的首次公開發行之發起人。在2020年8月至11月期間，我們透過BOC Yellowstone投資約7.8 百萬美元，購買3,399,724股Class B普通股及7,719,779張不可贖回私募權證，每張權證可購買1股Class A普通股，每股價格為11.50美元。2021年8月，Yellowstone與Sky Harbour LLC（簡稱為"SHG"），一家專注於建造、出租及管理商業航空機庫的私人航空基礎設施開發商，簽訂業務結合協議。該業務結合於2022年1月25日完成，Yellowstone更名為Sky Harbour Group Corporation（簡稱為"Sky Harbour"）。Sky Harbour的Class A普通股於紐約證券交易所（NYSE）以符號"SKYH"交易，其購買Class A普通股的權證則以符號"SKYH.WS"交易。

2021年9月，透過我們的一家子公司，我們直接投資了55 百萬美元至SHG，並取得Series B優先單位，我們稱之為"Sky Series B Preferred Units"。在Sky Harbour企業併購成功後，此投資轉換為5,500,000股Sky Harbour的A類普通股，基於每股假設價值10.00美元。2021年12月，我們同意在Sky Harbour企業併購完成後，透過購買4,500,000股A類普通股，提供Sky Harbour額外45 百萬美元。該企業併購於2022年1月完成。截至2025年12月31日，我們已出售1,015,537股Sky Harbour A類普通股，取得約11.2 百萬美元的總收入。截至2025年12月31日，我們持有11,671,494股Sky Harbour A類普通股，以及7,719,779股Sky Harbour選擇權。

2021 年，我們於 BOAM 公司內設立 BFR Fund 子公司，以經營預計的建案出租業務，專注於開發、興建及管理單戶離宅與/或聯排住宅，用以長期出租。我們投資約 15 百萬美元的資金，用以資金融通這些專案的初始收購，並隨後籌集第三方資金，與我們的資金一同投資。BFR Fund 初期取得內華達州的土地，計畫開發、興建並營運建案出租社區。然而，市場面臨的挑戰，包括利率上漲以及無法達成我們認為適當的風險調整後報酬，已促使我們轉向出售 BFR Fund 所有權的土地資產給公開上市的住宅建商。因此，我們將比原訂目標更早結束 BFR Fund。我們已將現金資產中未投資的部分歸還給 BFR Fund 合夥人，並在出售 BFR Fund 所有權的土地資產時，也將該資金歸還給 BFR Fund 合夥人。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析，並與本年度10-K申報表中其他處所出現之合併財務報表及相關附註一併參考。下列討論包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際之結果與某些事件之時程，可能與這些前瞻性陳述所預期者有重大差異，原因在於某些因素，包括下文所討論者，以及於「總結風險因素」與「項目1A. 風險因素」所列述者。請同時參閱標題為「關於前瞻性陳述之警示」之段落。
目前我們從事戶外看板廣告、寬頻服務、擔保保險及相關經紀業務，以及資產管理業務。此外，我們持有商業不動產管理與經紀服務之少數投資，一家專注於汽車貸款市場服務之銀行，以及一家專注於建設、出租與管理商業航空機庫之私人航空基礎設施開發商。

戶外看板廣告。2015年6月，我們透過我們全資子公司Link收購位於美國南部與威斯康辛州之較小看板公司，開始我們的看板業務運作。2018年7月與8月，我們收購三個較大看板公司的股權或資產，使我們的總看板數增加至約2,900個。此外，自該日期起，我們已進行數次較小規模的看板收購。我們認為我們是美國中西部市場主要的戶外看板廣告公司。截至2025年12月31日，我們運作約3,900個看板，約有7,500個廣告面。我們的主要業務目標之一是持續透過收購美國現有看板業務，取得更多看板資產，當這些收購價格在我們認為對我們而言具有吸引力時。

擔保保險。2015年9月，我們設立了一家保險子公司GIG，用以擁有與經營處理高交易量、低保單金額之商業財產與意外保險業務。2016年4月，我們的擔保保險業務開始運作，透過收購一傢俱有全國網路基礎設施之擔保保險經紀公司。2016年12月，我們完成收購UCS，一家擔保保險公司，當時僅在九個州有發行擔保債券的許可。UCS現在已取得在所有五十個州與華盛頓特區運作的許可。此外，我們也收購了位於美國各個地區之擔保保險經紀公司。未來我們可能擴展我們的保險業務至其他類型的保險，這些保險可能具有與擔保相似的特徵，例如高交易量與低平均保單 premium 之保險業務，這些業務歷來具有相似的經濟特性。

寬頻服務。2020年3月，我們透過收購FibAire的幾乎全部業務資產，開始我們的寬頻服務業務，FibAire是一家服務美國亞利桑那州南部社區超過8,000位客戶的鄉村寬頻互聯網供應商，提供高速固定無線電網服務，並正在建設選擇性亞利桑那州市場的全纖維到家網路。2020年12月，我們收購UBB的幾乎全部業務資產，UBB是一家提供高速互聯網服務給超過10,000位客戶的寬頻互聯網供應商，服務範圍遍及猶他州。2021年9月，我們宣佈啟動Fiber Fast Homes, LLC，與建商、開發商及建屋出租社區合作，建設纖維到家基礎設施，並為居民提供纖維互聯網服務。2022年4月，我們收購InfoWest的幾乎全部業務資產，InfoWest是一家提供纖維與固定無線電網互聯網服務的供應商，服務範圍遍及美國南部與中部猶他州、北部亞利桑那州與內華達州Moapa Valley。此外，過去幾年我們也收購了位於猶他州的其他小型寬頻業務。截至2025年12月31日，我們擁有約49,500位寬頻客戶（19,900位纖維客戶）與48,300個纖維通訊點。我們希望持續在亞利桑那州、佛羅裏達州、內華達州、猶他州及其他地區擴張。

自2015年9月起，我們已進行一系列投資於商業不動產、商業不動產管理與經紀服務業務以及資產管理業務。我們目前持有Logic的30%股權。2023年5月1日，我們的BOAM子公司以現金與BOC Class A普通股總價值5,016,494美元，收購24th Street的100%股權，不包括BOAM的股權。交易前，BOAM間接持有24th Street的48%股權。交易對價包含現金2,759,072美元，另外1,254,102美元現金待持回，以及45,644股BOC Class A普通股（根據交易閉幕前兩日的30個營業日內BOC Class A普通股平均收盤價計算）。交易中發行的股票未註冊，且無註冊權。買賣協議也規定根據表現支付持回金額，以及某些其他潛在有限的買斷付款。此外，我們透過我們的子公司，已投資總計600萬美元於24th Street Funds。這些基金由24th Street管理，專注於secured lending與直接投資於商業不動產的機會。

2017年12月，我們投資1000萬美元於DFH的普通單位，DFH是Dream Finders Homes, LLC的母公司，一家全國性住宅建商。除了住宅建造業務，DFH的子公司還為購屋者提供房貸貸款發放與房地產保險服務。2021年1月25日，Dream Finders Homes, Inc.，DFH的全資子公司，完成首次公開發行，Dream Finders Homes, Inc.成為控股公司與DFH的唯一管理人。首次公開發行完成後，我們持有的DFH普通單位轉換為4,681,099股Dream Finders Homes, Inc.的Class A普通股，我們的一家子公司在首次公開發行中又購入120,000股Class A普通股。自DFH首次公開發行以來至2022年12月31日，我們已出售所有4,801,099股DFH Class A普通股，總計約8100萬美元。
2018年5月，透過我們的子公司，我們投資約1900萬美元，購入CB&T的普通股，CB&T是Crescent的私人控股母公司。我們的投資現在代表CB&T已發行普通股的15.6%。Crescent位於紐奧良，其收入主要來自美國各州的間接次級汽車貸款業務。

2020年10月，本公司之子公司BOC Yellowstone擔任特殊目的收購公司Yellowstone Acquisition Company（簡稱Yellowstone）之經承銷公開發行之經理人。於2020年8月至11月期間，本公司透過BOC Yellowstone投資約7.8 百萬美元，購買3,399,724股Class B普通股及7,719,779張不可贖回私募權證，每張權證可購買1股Class A普通股，每股價格為11.50美元。2021年8月，Yellowstone與專注於建造、出租及管理商業航空機庫之Sky Harbour LLC簽訂業務結合協議。該業務結合於2022年1月25日完成，Yellowstone更名為Sky Harbour Group Corporation。Sky Harbour之Class A普通股於紐約證券交易所美國市場（NYSE American）交易，代號為"SKYH"，其購買Class A普通股之權證於該市場交易，代號為"SKYH.WS"。

2021年9月，透過我們的一家子公司，我們直接投資了55百萬美元至SHG，並取得Series B優先單位。在Sky Harbour企業組合成功完成後，此投資轉換為5,500,000股Sky Harbour的Class A普通股，基於每股假設價值10.00美元。2021年12月，我們同意在Sky Harbour企業組合關閉時，透過購買4,500,000股Class A普通股，提供Sky Harbour額外45百萬美元。此企業組合於2022年1月完成。截至2025年12月31日，我們已出售1,015,537股Sky Harbour Class A普通股，取得約11.2百萬美元的總收入。截至2025年12月31日，我們持有11,671,494股Sky Harbour Class A普通股，以及7,719,779股Sky Harbour選擇權。

2021 年，我們於 BOAM 公司內設立 BFR Fund 子公司，以經營預期的建案出租業務，專注於開發、興建及管理單戶離宅與/或聯排住宅，用以進行長期出租。我們投資約 15 百萬美元的資金，用以籌措這些專案的初始收購，並隨後籌集第三方資金，與我們的資金一同投資。BFR Fund 初期取得內華達州的土地，計畫開發、興建並運作建案出租社區。然而，市場面臨的挑戰，包括利率上漲以及無法達成我們認為適當的風險調整後回報，已促使我們轉向出售 BFR Fund 所擁有土地資產給公開上市的住宅建商。因此，我們將提前結束 BFR Fund 的業務，較原計畫提早回歸 BFR Fund 合夥人未投資的現金，並在出售 BFR Fund 所擁有土地資產時，同時將該資金回歸 BFR Fund 合夥人。

{'original': 'In July 2023, we invested approximately $3 million in voting preferred stock of MyBundle, a company serving the broadband industry.', 'translated': '民國 112 年 7 月，本公司投資約 3 百萬美元於 MyBundle 之投票優先股，MyBundle 為服務寬頻產業之公司。'}

在每項業務中，我們希望擴大地理範圍及市場佔有率，並致力於建立競爭優勢及/或品牌名稱，以成為客戶的區隔因素。我們的保險市場主要服務小型承包商、中小企業及個人，他們需要提供擔保債券（i）用於其政府機構及其他機構的工作，（ii）用於合同義務，或（iii）以符合監管要求及其他需求。我們已將UCS業務的執照擴展至全美50州及華盛頓特區，並開發並推出電子平台，使獨立保險經紀人更易於且更有效率地購買擔保保險。在戶外廣告方面，我們的計畫是透過收購看板資產來持續擴大此業務。我們預期將在亞利桑那州、佛羅裏達州、內華達州、猶他州及其他地區擴大寬頻服務。未來，我們預期在保險領域擴大所提供的服務範圍，持續擴大看板業務及寬頻服務，並可能考慮收購其他業務，以及投資其他產業，儘管我們預期在未來幾年內會將重點放在成長現有業務線。我們決定擴展至這些目前服務的產業或已投資的產業之外，將基於取得能提供可持續獲利機會的企業，且我們認為這些企業的獲利潛力相對於所使用的資本而言具有吸引力，而在投資方面，我們認為這些投資有潛力提供優良回報。

我們希望進入我們認為未來幾年服務需求將成長的市場，這通常因進入門檻及/或這些服務的長期需求預期所致。在戶外看板業務中，政府限制往往會限制新增看板的數量。同時，看板技術的進步提供了透過數位顯示技術及其他新技術來提高收入的機會。在擔保保險業務中，新保險公司必須經由州政府機構取得執照，這些機構對這些保險公司設有資本、管理及其他嚴格的規定。這些門檻在各州層面，法律常給予監管機構廣泛的裁量權，以對新進企業施加判斷性要求。此外，在某些擔保保險領域的新分銷渠道可能提供新的機會。在不動產管理服務市場，我們認為美國許多地區的商業不動產持續成長，將為管理服務提供可持續的機會。我們也認為我們對CB&T及Sky Harbour的投資，為每家公司提供了大幅成長業務的機會。我們將可用資金及UCS的盈餘資金投資於廣泛的證券，包括上市公司的股權證券、各種公司及政府債券及美國國庫券。在寬頻服務方面，我們認為我們的纖維到家服務能與傳統有線電視運營商競爭，因寬頻提供更高的傳輸速率及改善的用戶速度，且一旦建設完成，其他競爭者可能較不願意在我們服務的社區競爭。

headings: 與本公司及我們業務相關的風險
自成立以來，我們已產生營運虧損，我們預期在可預見的未來仍將持續產生虧損。
我們若無法成功識別並完成未來資產或業務的收購，可能會降低未來潛在獲利，減少可用現金，並延緩我們預期的成長。
我們可能在整合所收購公司或業務的運作時遇到困難，並可能因此產生重大成本。
與我們業務擴張相關的營運費用增加，可能會對我們營運收入產生負面影響。
我們可能因商譽及其他無形資產減損費用而遭受損失。
我們可能透過公開或私下的發行，籌措額外的股本資金，並根據我們 2022 年長期激勵計畫發行股本證券，任何這些舉措都可能大幅稀釋您的投資。
我們對 Sky Harbour Group Corporation 的 A 級普通股及 Sky 權證及其他公開交易及私有持有的證券的投資，涉及相當程度的風險。
我們有風險可能被視為需依1940年投資公司法註冊之投資公司。
Link及BOB之債務中之限制性條款可能限制管理階層對某些業務事項之裁量權。
若我們無法有效管理利率風險，將可能影響我們之現金流及營運結果。
我們可能透過債務融資方式籌措額外資金，而此等債務融資安排可能包含條款，若未遵守，將可能對我們之財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我們可能無法取得資金。
惡劣經濟條件可能對我們之營運結果及財務狀況造成負面影響。
氣候變遷、極端天氣、自然災害、公共衛生危機及其他外部事件可能對我們之業務造成重大影響。
我們可能無法聘僱足夠數量之關鍵員工及其他經驗或具資格之工作者。
我們嚴重依賴於我們的高階管理團隊。
我們的高階主管與董事可能會在他們對我們的義務與對關聯機構的義務之間產生利益衝突。
有關資料隱私與資料保護的法律與規範之變更，可能對我們的業務產生重大不利影響。
政府規範可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景產生不利影響。
擔保保險。我們必須遵守高度管制的保險產業的規範，隨著我們持續追求該產業的機會。
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股股份屬高度風險性投資，涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所討論的所有風險，以及本年度報告中所包含的其他資訊。若任何下列風險或不確定性實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流量及前景造成重大不利影響。此外，尚有其他風險或不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知，或本公司認為不重要，也可能對本公司業務的財務狀況、營運成果或前景造成重大不利影響。本公司無法保證下列風險因素中所討論的任何事件不會發生。如發生上述情況，本公司A類普通股的市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。

我們自 2015 年以來每年均發生營運虧損，當時 Magnolia 和 Boulderado 購買本公司過半數股權，出售先前業務並開始新業務活動。我們截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日的財務年度營運虧損約為 3.9 百萬美元及 8.5 百萬美元。截至目前為止，我們主要透過發行證券來資助營運。此外，隨著我們取得其他業務，我們會持續產生折舊及攤銷費用，這些費用通常會分攤於多個會計年度，以及完成這些併購的費用，這些費用會於發生時直接費用化。我們的虧損也可能包含 Sky Harbour 所產生虧損的按比例部分，因為我們根據權益法會計處理對 Sky Harbour 的投資。基於這些原因，我們可能持續產生重大虧損。這些虧損，以及其他因素，已對我們股東權益及營運資金產生並將繼續產生不利影響，我們無法保證我們將能成功執行我們的業務策略。

本公司認為取得對本公司業務有價值的資產或業務是業務策略的重要組成部分。本公司認為，不時可能出現多種併購機會，且任何該等併購可能具有重大影響。在任一時間點，與一個或多個潛在賣方的討論可能處於不同階段，包括在執行非綁定意向書後的談判。然而，任何該等討論，包括執行非綁定意向書，可能不會導致併購交易完成，本公司可能無法識別或完成任何併購。未來併購的成本與效益具有不確定性。此外，市場與產業對本公司併購的接受度，或缺乏接受度，可能不具正面影響，且超出本公司控制範圍。本公司無法預測任何併購公告或完成對本公司A類普通股交易價格的影響。若本公司識別適當的併購目標，可能因種種因素而無法以本公司認為可接受的條件取得企業，包括來自其他戰略買家或財務買家的競爭，其中一些買家可能擁有更多經驗或更易取得資金。

本公司業務屬資金密集型，任何該等交易可能涉及本公司支付大量現金。本公司可能需要透過公開或私下的債務或權益融資來執行成長策略並資助併購。當需要時，可能無法以可接受的條件或完全無法取得足夠的資金來源。若本公司透過發行額外權益證券來籌資，現有股東權益可能被稀釋。併購也可能導致本公司產生額外債務及或有負債，並導致季度營運結果與費用波動。若本公司未來資金資源不足，可能無法資助併購、把握業務機會或回應競爭壓力，任何情況均可能對本公司業務造成損害。
任何未來的併購可能面臨多種風險，包括但不限於：使用管理時間與資源追求未能成功完成的併購、對取得業務未來營運結果的錯誤假設，以及管理層注意力從現有營運或其他優先事項轉移的風險。未來的併購亦可能產生額外的折舊與攤銷費用，可能導致虧損。併購可能永遠無法達到本公司預期。
若本公司未能識別並完成其他業務或資產的併購，將可能對本公司財務狀況造成不利影響，且本公司可能無法成功執行業務策略的重要組成部分。
